The report RM07IDIF generates a list of
materials. This list can be used for the following purposes:
Check list to be used after the physical inventory count
Statistics of physical inventory documents for which differences have
already been or are still to be posted
Only those inventory differences are included that have been determined
adjustments made on the basis of a material document without physical
inventory document are not taken into account.

to display and print inventory differences in the given plant. (Object
First, the report generates a list of physical inventory documents
where the book inventory balance deviates from the counted stock.
For each physical inventory document, the following information is
Physical inventory document with physical inventory document items
Book inventory balance at time of count
Difference quantity (in local currency) and currency
